status.description: The issue is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.

comments.comment: Most recent failures here are MPI failing to start when the two client VMs are on different hosts (UCX Destination is unreachable); that is now LU-20952. This ticket stays for the data verification failure (Incorrect data on write), seen twice in three months with both clients on one host.

Moving fix version to 2.19 as part of 2.18 release preparation. If you feel this patch is urgent for 2.18, you can put this back. Note this doesn't stop it landing if ready: if the patch is ready and reviewed, it can still land for 2.18.

The data verification failure did not reproduce in 300 rounds of ior over NFSv3 with both clients on one host, and seen twice in three months it is too rare to chase without a new failure. If it shows up again, that failure is the one to look at.
